review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 16, 7:41 AM ET. It had Carlos Alcaraz 87% and Frances Tiafoe 13%.

Final: Carlos Alcaraz 2 – Frances Tiafoe 0. Right winner: it had Carlos Alcaraz at 87%.

review.body: Carlos Alcaraz to win: the algo gave it 87%, THE PICK — won.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body: The result goes into both players' Elo ratings at the next data run, so their next match is priced on it.
